annotations.description: Kaito is currently a 3/4 Ninja creature during your turn. Using +1 to get a Ninja emblem (+1/+1 to Ninjas) makes him a 4/5 attacker, which is decent. However, the opponent has no creatures on board and only 2 lands (Mountain + Soulstone Sanctuary), so the -2 stun ability has no targets worth hitting. The 0 ability (Surveil 2, draw a card if opponent lost life) wouldn't draw a card since the opponent hasn't lost life yet this turn - but Kaito is about to attack in combat. The optimal line might be to attack with Kaito first (dealing 3+ damage, making opponent lose life), then use the 0 ability post-combat... but planeswalker abilities are sorcery speed and must be used in main phase. Since Kaito attacks as a creature, you'd want to +1 before combat to make him a 4/5 attacker, or use 0 to surveil 2 (no draw since no life loss yet). The +1 is reasonable as it permanently buffs Kaito and any future Ninjas, making him attack as a 4/5. However, surveilling 2 with the 0 ability could help find better cards and improve card quality. This is close but the +1 is defensible since it provides a permanent emblem and a bigger attacker.

annotations.betterLine: Using the 0 ability to Surveil 2 could have been considered to improve card quality, though +1 for permanent buff is also reasonable. Both lines are close.
